title: Dispatch: olc5.9 use_item spends the printed turn resource (attempt 1, cloud)
description:
Implements capability eshyra-olc5.9 (read it and parent eshyra-olc5 notes: capability contract = operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real pack binding, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed). Branch eshyra-olc5.9.1 from origin/main 017f4279.

CURRENT STATE (verified by captain):
- Pack: operations[].activation.cost in {'action','bonus-action','reaction'} (also 'free'; 'consume' rows are potions/oils etc.). Evidence census: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemActivationCensus.json (362 rows; cost-null rows carry noneReason.cost - some say the spell's ordinary casting time governs).
- use_item: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolUseItem.ts -> useItem() in packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts (UseItemInput.characterId is the acting character). It does not touch turn resources today.
- Turn resources: packages/core/src/state/actionEconomy.ts spendTurnResource (resources 'action'|'bonus_action'|'reaction'|...; optional spellRef derives casting time and the bonus-action-spell rule from the spell record), beginTurn, readCombatTurnState. Tools toolSpendTurnResource.ts / toolBeginTurn.ts; turn loop/auditor in orchestrator/turnLoop.ts, turnAuditor.ts.
- Readiness: clause green only when every engineHook key is in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS (scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemCompiler.ts ~345). Operation readiness: packages/core/src/state/itemExecutionReadiness.ts (assertMagicItemOperationReady, deriveItemOperationReadinessInput). Activation action-economy hooks appear e.g. as F2 'activation action economy' / 'action-economy activation' on several clauses.

DESIGN (follow it; if any part proves wrong or under-specified by the pack, STOP and report in your notes instead of improvising):
1. When useItem executes an operation whose typed activation.cost is action / bonus-action / reaction AND the acting character is a participant in the campaign's active combat instance, spend the matching turn resource for that character via the existing spendTurnResource logic (activity text naming item + operation), in the SAME transaction as the item costs, BEFORE any item mutation: if the resource is unavailable (already used, not the participant's turn for action/bonus action, surprised, etc. - whatever spendTurnResource already enforces) use_item refuses and nothing is mutated. Outside combat, or when the actor is not a combat participant: no turn spend (record that in the result). Return the spend (resource, budget summary) in UseItemResult.
2. 'free' and 'consume' costs and cost-null operations spend nothing automatically - EXCEPT rule 3.
3. Spells cast from items: if an operation casts a spell that the pack binds to it as a typed reference (find how operations/effects reference spell records; do NOT infer from prose), pass that spellRef to the spend so the bonus-action-spell rule and casting-time checks apply. If the operation has no typed cost, spend according to the spell record's casting time (action/bonus action/reaction only; longer casting times spend nothing automatically and are reported as DM-adjudicated). If a typed cost CONTRADICTS the bound spell's casting time, do not guess: list every such row in your notes and fail closed for it (refuse auto-spend with a clear error) unless the printed item text explicitly overrides casting time.
4. Operations whose printed actor is not the item's user (e.g. Rope of Entanglement escape-rope, Dust of Dryness smash-pellet 'someone', Immovable Rod release by another creature): identify from the census/pack; the acting character passed to use_item is the one charged. Document how the DM handles a non-character actor (spend_turn_resource on the combatant) in the tool description; do not add combatant item use.
5. Update the use_item tool description so the DM knows the turn resource is spent automatically in combat and must NOT also be spent with spend_turn_resource (prevent double spend). Check turnAuditor/turnLoop for any rule that would now flag or double count, and adjust consistently.
6. Land the action-economy engine hook(s) in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS only if the runtime now fully owns that hook's contract for EVERY clause carrying it; otherwise do not land and explain. Regenerate the pack per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md (verify-dnd5e-srd-pack, inventory --check). Report the EXACT ready-operation delta (run deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady over all item x variant x operation combos before/after; 23 ready today) and for each newly-ready operation say why its full printed behaviour is faithful or explicitly DM-adjudicated. If a newly-ready op would execute something unfaithful, don't land the hook enabling it.

CONFORMANCE TESTS (real pack records): action-cost op in combat on actor's turn spends action and a second action-cost use is refused with no item mutation (charges unchanged); bonus-action op; reaction op off-turn; out-of-combat use spends nothing; spell-casting op passes spellRef (bonus-action spell rule interacts); cost-null spell op spends by casting time; contradiction rows fail closed; atomicity (refused turn spend leaves item state untouched).

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: design as built, hooks landed or not with reasons, exact ready delta with per-operation faithfulness note, list of spell-casting-time contradictions and non-user-actor operations.
notes:
Remote launch fell back to LOCAL execution (harness worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-*, branch eshyra-olc5.9.1). User chose 2026-10-14: let it finish locally.
COMPLETION: commit 936c0f62 on branch eshyra-olc5.9.1 (pushed). verify:worktree green: 362 files passed/2 skipped, 6768 tests passed/3 skipped; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack matches exactly (no pack or importer change). DESIGN AS BUILT: new state/itemTurnResource.ts (pure planItemTurnResource over typed pack fields only). useItem calls it right after the operation resolves and before any state/cost work; in an active combat instance it calls spendTurnResource for the acting character in the same transaction, so a refused spend (already used, not their turn for action/bonus action, surprised, dead) throws ItemStateError and nothing is mutated. UseItemResult.turnResource = spent {resource, source activation-cost|spell-casting-time, activity, spellRef?, castingTimeOverride?, spellSelectedByDm?, budget} or not-spent {not-in-combat|free-activation|consumed-item|casting-time-dm-adjudicated}; omitted when op has neither typed cost nor bound spell. cost action/bonus-action/reaction spend that resource; free/consume spend nothing; cost-null + typed castSpell spellRef spends by casting time (1 action/bonus action/1 reaction; longer = DM-adjudicated, not spent). spellRef is passed to spendTurnResource so the bonus-action-spell rule applies. Characters have no combat roster: any character is a participant while a combat instance is active. Added SpendTurnResourceInput.itemOperation (use_item only) to skip the prose cast guard when no spellRef is bound. Tool description, protocol.ts text and deterministicCapabilityInventory updated (use_item spends it; do NOT also spend_turn_resource); turnAuditor/turnLoop have no coupling so unchanged. Fail closed: >1 distinct bound spellRef, unresolvable spellRef, unknown cost string refuse in combat. HOOKS NOT LANDED: F2 action-economy activation sits on 143 clauses incl. cost-null non-spell payload ops (Hammer of Thunderbolts, Javelin of Lightning, Rod of Lordly Might drain-life/paralyze) and consume potions the runtime does not own; activation action economy (93, state-machine activate/deactivate carry no typed cost), item activation and action-budget ownership, reaction and action economy likewise. Even with all hypothetically landed the ready set stays 23. READY DELTA: 23 before (of 463 item x variant x op combos), 23 after, delta 0, no new faithfulness claims. CASTING-TIME CONTRADICTIONS (5 rows, printed text explicitly states activation, held in PRINTED_CASTING_TIME_OVERRIDES, printed activation spent and castingTimeOverride surfaced): elemental-gem#break-gem (action vs 1 minute); orb-of-dragonkind#cast-scrying (action vs 10 minutes); staff-of-the-magi#cast-conjure-elemental (action vs 1 minute); staff-of-the-woodlands#cast-awaken (action vs 8 hours); ring-of-jumping#cast-jump (bonus-action vs 1 action). A test asserts the override set equals exactly the contradictions computed from the bundled pack (new ones fail closed) and that each has census costSentence naming the activation. JUDGMENT CALL for captain: no pack field marks explicit override; I treated the census-evidenced typed cost as that evidence; to refuse instead, empty the 5-row set. Other: Necklace of Prayer Beads cast-bead-spell (bonus-action, DM-selected spellRefs) spends bonus action with no spellRef, spellSelectedByDm reported; orb m7 castSpell uses key spell not spellRef and is ignored; consume-cost potions with long spells spend nothing. NON-USER-ACTOR OPS (acting character passed to use_item is charged; DM uses spend_turn_resource on the combatant for others, documented in tool description): Dust of Dryness smash-pellet (Someone), Immovable Rod release-rod (you or another creature), Rope of Entanglement escape-rope (restrained target) and release-creature (bonus action). NOT DONE: activate/deactivate transitions and cost-null non-spell ops spend nothing (follow-up bead filed); activation.equipment is olc5.10.
